sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:32

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:32:1
items.html:
The three first Nekudot, etc., from them the Partzuf of Atik was made: The explanation is that the Partzuf of Keter, which is called Atik, has in it ten Sefirot in the secret of the inner HaVaYaH: the tip of the Yod is the secret of the Keter in it itself, that is, Keter of Keter; and the Yod in it is Aba and Hochma; and the first Hey in it is Ima and Bina; and the Vav in it is ZA; and the last Hey in it is Malchut.
And from each and every letter of the inner HaVaYaH — that is, the ten Sefirot in the Partzuf of Keter itself — a complete HaVaYaH comes out to the outside, in the discernment of a garment: from the Yod in it, the Partzuf AB comes out; and from the first Hey in it, the Partzuf SAG comes out, for AB is called Aba and SAG is called Ima, as is known; and from the Vav in it, the Partzuf of ZA comes out, which clothes it from the Tabur downward; and from the last Hey, the Partzuf of Malchut comes out. And know that it is so in every complete Partzuf: the Partzuf of Keter in it is regarded as the internal one, and in it itself there are likewise inner AB, SAG, MA and BON, which are called the inner HaVaYaH, as above. And apart from these, it has outer AB, SAG, MA and BON, which are discernments of garments to it: AB and SAG clothe above the Tabur, and MA and BON, which are ZON, clothe below the Tabur, as above in the words of the ARI (page 389, item 1. See there. And likewise in Etz Chaim, Gate 5, Chapter 1, at its end).
Now, in the Partzuf of Nekudim, only the discernment of the Partzuf of Keter in it came out, together with the AB, SAG, MA and BON that are in its own internality; and it did not manage to bring out the outer AB, SAG, MA and BON, because its seven lower Sefirot were broken, and also the posterior of the GAR in it were annulled, as is known.
But the discernment of the face of its first three remained, meaning that everything that was in these GAR from the beginning of their emanation is called face, and all this remained and nothing of it was annulled.
And this is what he says: from the three first Nekudot, both in the discernments of the lights and in the discernment of the vessels, the Partzuf of Atik alone was made — for the reason that the outer AB, SAG, MA and BON have no hold whatsoever in the GAR of the Partzuf of Keter. And this is what is said, “and no other force is mingled in them”; for even the Partzuf AB begins to come out from the Peh of the Partzuf of Keter downward, which is below the Malchut of its Rosh, and all the more so the other Partzufim.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:32:2
items.html: In the seven lower Nekudot there are many forces mingled in them. That is, those discernments from which the four outer Partzufim, AB, SAG, MA and BON, which clothe upon it, must come out; for they had not yet come out from it in the world of Nekudim, as above. As he goes on to explain, that there is a discernment from which AA must come out, etc.
